posts.cooked:
I forgot to do synchro init before submitting my BPT_assignment_2 only , But the test cases passed . Will that cause a problem while evaluation or should i submit it again ?

This a very minute doubt , apologies for asking it .

posts.name: Seetaramayya Lavu
posts.cooked:
Is it BPT_1 problem_2?

if it is, '“synchro init” is not necessary for all problems. run it only when it is mentioned in the question to prepare base for the solution. In BPT_1, I think only first problem needs it

Yeah , okay
i thought we had to do it for every BPT problem , just one more doubt if you don’t mind
Are you also facing some difficulties while solving the BPT1_problem_3 .
if not , what resources you are using ? As far as i remember week1 & week 2 lectures don’t cover that part .

posts.name: Seetaramayya Lavu
posts.cooked:
we can create script.sh using any text editor like ‘vim’.
In linux ’man diff’ and ‘man comm’ commands will show the usage of ‘diff’ and ‘comm’. this will work even in windows terminal, but linux based systems gives clear explanation from my observation. We can run it on VM provided to us by IITM after connecting to it. Explanation from these man pages is sufficient to solve this problem.
To make a file executable “chmod +x filename” works.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: All the 4 questions are from Week 1 & Week 2 concepts only. The hint given in the question should help you. Knowing how to use man pages is essential.

posts.name: Subramanian M K (MKS)
posts.cooked:
For the BPT problems (specifically BPT1_problems_1 to 4), are we expected to have our solution stored in a file with specific name?

I see the mention of file named ‘sript.sh’ in one of the answers above. So, should our solution be in a file specifically named ‘script.sh’ in the corresponding BPT1_problem_* directory?

The reason for asking this is : What should the student do to ensure ‘Synchro eval’ can test the solution? Should the solution code be stored in a file with specific name?

Please clarify. Thanks!

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: For the questions 1 & 2 creating script.sh is not required. Wherever mentioned, yes you should create scripts with the same name as mentioned in the question. @24f1002419_IITM_MKS
